other_conditions: Must be a resident of Uttarakhand
Must belong to one of the minority religions: Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Buddhist, Parsi, or Jain
Must have passed the previous class (eligible for classes 1 to 10)
Cannot be receiving any other scholarship in the current academic session
Must be studying in a government, council or recognized school/madrassa
Must have a bank account (own or guardian’s) in a CBS branch seeded with an Aadhaar number, with correct account number and IFSC code
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of Rs. 50 per month for classes 1‑5, Rs. 80 per month for classes 6‑8, and Rs. 120 per month for classes 9‑10, each for up to 12 months.
documents_required: Income certificate issued by the competent authority authorized by the State Government
application_link: Visit the official National Scholarship Portal
